2610.04942.title: Zero-Shot Time-Series Question Answering via Decoupled Perception and Reasoning
2610.04942.paper_summary: Time-series question answering (TSQA) requires grounding linguistic queries and diverse answer formats in complex numerical observations. However, existing methods heavily overfit to specific datasets and struggle to generalize when input series, question contexts, and answer requirements shift simultaneously. To address this challenge, we propose TSHarness, an agentic framework that establishes a decoupled workflow for cross-dataset zero-shot TSQA. At its core, TSHarness divides and conquers numerical perception and contextual reasoning via a structured Time-Series Perception State (TPS). Guided by a reusable memory of analytical knowledge, a learned Tool Selector adaptively invokes numerical tools to extract salient statistical and temporal features into the TPS. The answering agent then performs semantic reasoning over the TPS to generate target outputs, triggering iterative re-perception through the feedback loop when evidence is deemed insufficient. By separating numerical feature extraction from question-specific reasoning, TSHarness eliminates the need for target-side training or answer feedback, providing a generalizable, cost-efficient foundation for zero-shot TSQA.
2610.04942.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列問題回答（TSQA）需要將語言查詢和多樣的答案格式與複雜的數值觀察相結合。<lb/>然而，現有的方法在特定數據集上過度擬合，並在輸入序列、問題上下文和答案要求同時變化時難以泛化。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了TSHarness，一個建立跨數據集零樣本TSQA的解耦工作流程的代理框架。<lb/>TSHarness的核心是通過結構化的時間序列感知狀態（TPS）來分而治之，處理數值感知和上下文推理。<lb/>在可重用的分析知識記憶的指導下，學習的工具選擇器自適應地調用數值工具，將顯著的統計和時間特徵提取到TPS中。<lb/>然後，回答代理在TPS上執行語義推理以生成目標輸出，當證據被認為不足時，通過反饋循環觸發迭代重新感知。<lb/>通過將數值特徵提取與問題特定推理分開，TSHarness消除了對目標端訓練或答案反饋的需求，為零樣本TSQA提供了一個可泛化的、成本效益高的基礎。
